comment: Strict exclusion ledger for the @gjsify/napi conformance oracle. Each entry documents ONE program the GJS-under-shim leg cannot pass byte-identically to the Node reference, with a precise reason. An UNLISTED failure fails the harness; a LISTED program that starts passing also fails (stale entry — remove it). Node (the reference) must always pass. Every reason here is a Phase-0-deferred capability, NOT a conformance defect in the implemented surface.

entries.reason: Exercises napi_create_bigint_words / napi_get_value_bigint_words (the BigInt word-array ABI) via TestWords/CreateTooBigBigInt/MakeBigIntWordsThrow — Phase-0 loud stubs. The int64/uint64 BigInt surface (TestInt64/TestUint64/IsLossless) works on both runtimes; only the word-array marshalling is deferred.

Exercises node_api_create_external_string_latin1 / node_api_create_external_string_utf16 (external, caller-owned string storage) via TestLatin1External/TestUtf16External — Phase-0 loud stubs. All copying Latin1/UTF-8/UTF-16 create/extract paths pass on both runtimes; only external (zero-copy) strings are deferred.

Exercises napi_create_external_arraybuffer (external, caller-owned ArrayBuffer backing) via External() — a Phase-0 loud stub. Multiply / CreateTypedArray (all 12 kinds) / Detach / IsDetached pass on both runtimes; only external ArrayBuffers are deferred.

Exercises napi_create_reference with refcount 0 (WEAK references): the reference does not preserve value identity under the shim, as the in-GC weak-reference regime (toggle-ref-driven weak/strong tracking + external finalizers) is deferred in Phase 0. The strong-reference + registered-symbol (node_api_symbol_for) surface works.

binding.gyp defines NAPI_EXPERIMENTAL and the addon references node_api_post_finalizer — outside the Phase-0 NAPI_VERSION=10 non-experimental ABI surface, so the shim cannot resolve the symbol at dlopen (RTLD_NOW). Additionally exercises the in-GC finalizer regime (pure finalizer in the current tick), which is deferred.

binding.gyp defines NAPI_EXPERIMENTAL and the addon references node_api_post_finalizer — outside the Phase-0 NAPI_VERSION=10 non-experimental ABI surface, so the shim cannot resolve the symbol at dlopen (RTLD_NOW).

binding.gyp defines NAPI_EXPERIMENTAL and the addon references node_api_create_object_with_properties — outside the Phase-0 NAPI_VERSION=10 non-experimental ABI surface, so the shim cannot resolve the symbol at dlopen (RTLD_NOW).

binding.gyp defines NAPI_EXPERIMENTAL and the addon references node_api_is_sharedarraybuffer — outside the Phase-0 NAPI_VERSION=10 non-experimental ABI surface, so the shim cannot resolve the symbol at dlopen (RTLD_NOW).

Two independent blockers. (1) The addon opts into NAPI_EXPERIMENTAL and references node_api_is_sharedarraybuffer / node_api_create_sharedarraybuffer — outside the Phase-0 NAPI_VERSION=10 non-experimental ABI, so it cannot dlopen under the shim (RTLD_NOW). (2) GJS disables shared memory + Atomics at the realm level (getSharedMemoryAndAtomicsEnabled() == false), so `SharedArrayBuffer` is not even defined in the JS global — the test's own `new SharedArrayBuffer(...)` throws ReferenceError under gjs. Unportable regardless of (1).

Exercises the WEAK-reference regime: after a reference's count drops to 0, object-like values must survive as weak pointers until GC while primitives/strings/bigints are released immediately, and a global (registered) symbol stays strong forever. This in-GC weak-reference regime (toggle-ref-driven weak/strong tracking) is deferred in Phase 0 — the same reason test_reference is ledgered. First divergence: a refcount-0 reference does not preserve value identity under the shim (getRefValue returns undefined where Node still returns the weakly-held value).

createRef registers a strong-referenced JS function whose finalizer, run at environment shutdown, calls napi_get_named_property(global, 'setTimeout') and asserts napi_cannot_run_js||napi_ok (NAPI_VERSION 10) or napi_pending_exception||napi_ok (NAPI_VERSION 9). The shim runs env-teardown finalizers with JS still callable (the node-gi §5e SIGSEGV-avoidance discipline — teardown finalizers may create values) rather than implementing Node's can_call_into_js gate that short-circuits JS-entering napi calls to those statuses; a finalizer that enters JSAPI while the GjsContext is being disposed is outside the Phase-0 teardown model. Deferred.
